en.headline: Man falls from platform at Sorrento and strikes foreign domestic helper
en.dek: Police said both remained conscious after the man was suspected to have lost his footing at a barbecue at the West Kowloon residential clubhouse on Saturday evening.
body: Emergency services responded at about 7.43pm on Saturday to an incident at Sorrento, 1 Austin Road West in West Kowloon, after a man fell from a higher level and struck a woman on a platform below.

The woman was walking with a companion when she was hit. Both were conscious when rescuers arrived. The man was taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital and the woman, a foreign domestic helper, was taken to Kwong Wah Hospital. Police are investigating the circumstances.

Preliminary information indicated the man had been attending a barbecue gathering at the residential clubhouse and was suspected to have lost his footing after consuming alcohol. He was seen wearing a neck brace and carried on a stretcher into hospital.
The platform was not high above the ground, according to reports from the scene. No further details on the extent of injuries were immediately available.

zh.headline: 西九擎天半島男子疑酒後失足墮平台壓中外傭
zh.dek: 警方指晚上約7時43分接報，柯士甸道西1號一名男子從高處墮下壓中途經女外傭，兩人清醒分別送院。
body: 周六晚上約7時43分，西九龍柯士甸道西1號擎天半島發生意外。一名男子從高處墮下，壓中平台上途經的一名女外傭。
女事主與友人同行時被壓中。救援人員到場時兩人清醒。男事主被送往伊利沙伯醫院，女外傭則被送往廣華醫院治理。警方正調查事件。
現場消息指，男子疑在住宅會所燒烤期間飲酒後失足墮下。他戴着頸箍，由擔架床送院，神情痛苦。
據現場了解，平台離地不高。意外原因仍在調查中。
